events.title: Demo Update | September 23, 2026
events.summary: Automatic Merging and Ascension Gifts - In Path to Ascension, acquiring an artifact or material with the same name and grade as one you own now merges them automatically. Merging can continue if another matching item is available at the new grade. The result keeps an owned item's position, including its equipment slot.- Each artifact grade-up grants one random material a grade below the artifact's new grade: Mortal to Spirit grants Mortal, Spirit to Immortal grants Spirit, and Immortal to Divine

events.title: All-Night Ascension Demo Update — September 20, 2026
events.summary: True Intent Rework- Reworked all 64 True Intents. Their effects apply throughout your current run as soon as you acquire them. They require no equipment slots, take up no space on your formation board or in your backpack, and use no Divine Sense. Each True Intent can only be acquired once per run.- True Intent rewards from minor realm advancements now show the effects of up to three options. Each reward offers one free reroll. If no eligible options remain, you receive 8 Spirit Stones instead.-
